attendance_intro: Expo Quest is designed to be enjoyed in person at {expo}.
attendance_detail: You'll need to be at the expo to complete challenges, earn stars or claim rewards. These activities aren't available remotely. We'd love to see you there!
welcome_subtitle: Explore the expo. Collect stars. Take home rewards.
name_intro: What should we call you when you win?
name_hint: 2–32 characters. Choose a nickname, not private information. This name may be announced publicly if you win.
email_intro: Add your email to enter the daily prize draws.
email_image_hint: Tap the image to see the daily prizes
email_optional_hint: No email? No problem. You can still explore, complete quests and redeem your star rewards.
email_privacy_notice: You can play without email; a pseudonymous identifier and gameplay records still synchronize to operate the event. Email is optional for quests and needed for daily draws and prize contact, not newsletters or advertising. A parent or guardian should provide their own email for a child. Supabase hosts participant records in London. We keep email addresses and daily-draw records {retention}. Removing email leaves the draws but does not erase every server record; contact us for full deletion. {contact} Read the full policy for data uses, providers and your rights. Continuing acknowledges the notice; it is not blanket consent.
email_delete_explanation:
An email address is needed to take part in the daily draws: it is the only way we can contact you if you win.

Your stars and rewards will not change.

If you're offline, deletion will reach our server when you reconnect.
draw_entry_rules: Your email gives you 1 entry. Every star earned adds 1 entry, including quest bonuses. Spending stars does not reduce entries. Entries accumulate throughout the event. Each prize is drawn randomly from the entry pool. A winner cannot win again that day, but returns to the pool on following days. Challenge star values are set by LASEROX.
draw_eligibility:
Participation requires personal presence at the event. No purchase is required to earn stars or enter the draws. There is no minimum age restriction; a parent or guardian must provide their own email and handle prize contact for children. A valid email is required for draw participation and winner contact. Connect to the internet before the draw so your entries can reach the organizer; entries stored only on your phone cannot be included in the server's draw pool.

Prize names are listed above. Each day's prize list is finalized before that day's draw begins. There are no external sponsors. Apple and Google do not sponsor, administer or endorse these draws.

Winners are contacted by email and have 14 days from the prize email to reply. If a winner does not reply within 14 days, the organizer will draw a replacement winner. Prizes can be collected in person before the expo ends or shipped by arrangement through email.

Progress applies to the current event and will be cleared manually by the organizer before the next expo. Email is used for draws, prize delivery and support, not marketing. See the privacy policy for data handling and retention.
welcome_step_1_text: Try expo activities. Scan QR codes to collect stars and complete quests.
welcome_step_2_text: Visit the LASEROX booth to redeem the rewards you unlock.
welcome_step_3_text: Add an email for daily prize draws — or simply enjoy the adventure without one.
help_step_1_text: Open a quest, complete a task, then scan its QR code.
help_step_2_text: Challenges award stars once. Reach a quest’s target for bonus stars.
help_step_3_text: Tap Claim and show staff your QR. Scan their approval to collect your reward.
help_step_4_text: Add your email through Daily Draws. Ask LASEROX staff for draw times.
help_step_5_text: Progress saves on this phone and syncs when you reconnect.
